verdict.rationale: MotherDuck has built-in AI features such as Dives and AI functions, so a buyer could reasonably ask whether it can consume external MCP servers; the axis applies. The evidence only shows MotherDuck acting as an MCP server (remote and local servers that expose SQL tools to outside agents). That is the opposite role and earns no credit here, and nothing documents MotherDuck connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools.
